subject.title: fix(browser): preserve HTTP status in node-proxied browser errors

question: Is the copied live classifier output plus producer test coverage enough to waive full gateway-to-remote-browser-node after-fix proof for this PR?
rationale: The code path is source-clear, but the contributor has not shown the patched producer crossing `node.invoke` in a real remote browser-node run; only maintainers should accept that proof gap.

options.title: Require full-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal/log/live output from a patched gateway plus real remote browser node showing the 404 message crossing `node.invoke` and the retry firing before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: Treat the live classifier run plus producer tests as sufficient and proceed with ordinary maintainer review and CI gating.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the PR open but blocked until the contributor can run the full remote-node browser scenario.

recommendation.title: Require full-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal/log/live output from a patched gateway plus real remote browser node showing the 404 message crossing `node.invoke` and the retry firing before merge.
